div.div: طُمَّرَةٌ , (so in copies of the K and accord. to the TA,) with damm to the ط, and teshdeed and fet-h to the م; (TA;) or ↓ طُمُرَّةٌ , with two dammehs, and teshdeed to the ر; (O, and so accord. to the TK; [and this I think most probably the right;]) The first period of شَبَاب [i. e. youthfulness, or young manhood, &c.]: (O, K:) so in the saying mentioned and expl. by Fr, كَانَ ذٰلِكَ فِى طُمُرَّةِ شَبَابِهِ [That was in the first period of his youthfulness, &c.]. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
